text.KJV: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
text.ASV: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints that are in the whole of Achaia:
text.WEB: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

text.KJV: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
text.ASV: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
text.ASV: Blessed `be' the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;
text.WEB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;

text.KJV: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
text.ASV: who comforteth us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort them that are in any affliction, through the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
text.WEB: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

text.KJV: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
text.ASV: For as the sufferings of Christ abound unto us, even so our comfort also aboundeth through Christ.
text.WEB: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

text.KJV: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
text.ASV: But whether we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; or whether we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which worketh in the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer:
text.WEB: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

text.KJV: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
text.ASV: and our hope for you is stedfast; knowing that, as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so also are ye of the comfort.
text.WEB: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so also are you of the comfort.

text.KJV: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
text.ASV: For we would not have you ignorant, brethren, concerning our affliction which befell `us' in Asia, that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
text.WEB: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia, that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

text.KJV: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
text.ASV: yea, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raiseth the dead:
text.WEB: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

text.KJV: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
text.ASV: who delivered us out of so great a death, and will deliver: on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us;
text.WEB: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us;

text.KJV: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
text.ASV: ye also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift bestowed upon us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on our behalf.
text.WEB: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

text.KJV: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
text.ASV: For our glorifying is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
text.WEB: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

text.KJV: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
text.ASV: For we write no other things unto you, than what ye read or even acknowledge, and I hope ye will acknowledge unto the end:
text.WEB: For we write no other things to you, than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end;

text.KJV: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are our's in the day of the Lord Jesus.
text.ASV: as also ye did acknowledge us in part, that we are your glorying, even as ye also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
text.WEB: as also you acknowledged us in part, that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

text.KJV: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
text.ASV: And in this confidence I was minded to come first unto you, that ye might have a second benefit;
text.WEB: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit;

text.KJV: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
text.ASV: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come unto you, and of you to be set forward on my journey unto Judaea.
text.WEB: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

text.KJV: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
text.ASV: When I therefore was thus minded, did I show fickleness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be the yea yea and the nay nay?
text.WEB: When I therefore was thus determined, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

text.KJV: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
text.ASV: But as God is faithful, our word toward you is not yea and nay.
text.WEB: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

text.KJV: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
text.ASV: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, `even' by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not yea and nay, but in him is yea.
text.WEB: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, by me, Silvanus, and Timothy, was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

text.KJV: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
text.ASV: For how many soever be the promises of God, in him is the yea: wherefore also through him is the Amen, unto the glory of God through us.
text.WEB: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

text.KJV: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
text.ASV: Now he that establisheth us with you in Christ, and anointed us, is God;
text.WEB: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ, and anointed us, is God;

text.KJV: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
text.ASV: who also sealed us, and gave `us' the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
text.WEB: who also sealed us, and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

text.KJV: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
text.ASV: But I call God for a witness upon my soul, that to spare you I forbare to come unto Corinth.
text.WEB: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that I didn’t come to Corinth to spare you.

text.KJV: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
text.ASV: Not that we have lordship over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for in faith ye stand fast.
text.WEB: Not that we control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

text.KJV: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
text.ASV: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come again to you with sorrow.
text.WEB: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

text.KJV: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
text.ASV: For if I make you sorry, who then is he that maketh me glad but he that is made sorry by me?
text.WEB: For if I make you sorry, then who will make me glad but he who is made sorry by me?

text.KJV: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
text.ASV: And I wrote this very thing, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is `the joy' of you all.
text.WEB: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that, when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy would be shared by all of you.

text.KJV: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
text.ASV: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be made sorry, but that ye might know the love that I have more abundantly unto you.
text.WEB: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made sorry, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

text.KJV: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
text.ASV: But if any hath caused sorrow, he hath caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I press not too heavily) to you all.
text.WEB: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

text.KJV: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
text.ASV: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment which was `inflicted' by the many;
text.WEB: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

text.KJV: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
text.ASV: so that contrariwise ye should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his overmuch sorrow.
text.WEB: so that on the contrary you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

text.KJV: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
text.ASV: Wherefore I beseech you to confirm `your' love toward him.
text.WEB: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

text.KJV: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
text.ASV: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye are obedient in all things.
text.WEB: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

text.KJV: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
text.ASV: But to whom ye forgive anything, I `forgive' also: for what I also have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, for your sakes `have I forgiven it' in the presence of Christ;
text.WEB: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

text.KJV: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
text.ASV: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
text.WEB: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

text.KJV: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
text.ASV: Now when I came to Troas for the gospel of Christ, and when a door was opened unto me in the Lord,
text.WEB: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

text.KJV: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
text.ASV: I had no relief for my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went forth into Macedonia.
text.WEB: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus, my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

text.KJV: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
text.ASV: But thanks be unto God, who always leadeth us in triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest through us the savor of his knowledge in every place.
text.WEB: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

text.KJV: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
text.ASV: For we are a sweet savor of Christ unto God, in them that are saved, and in them that perish;
text.WEB: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God, in those who are saved, and in those who perish;

text.KJV: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
text.ASV: to the one a savor from death unto death; to the other a savor from life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
text.WEB: to the one a stench from death to death; to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

text.KJV: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
text.ASV: For we are not as the many, corrupting the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, speak we in Christ.
text.WEB: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

text.KJV: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
text.ASV: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? or need we, as do some, epistles of commendation to you or from you?
text.WEB: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

text.KJV: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
text.ASV: Ye are our epistle, written in our hearts, known and read of all men;
text.WEB: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men;

text.KJV: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
text.ASV: being made manifest that ye are an epistle of Christ, ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in tables `that are' hearts of flesh.
text.WEB: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

text.KJV: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
text.ASV: And such confidence have we through Christ to God-ward:
text.WEB: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God;

text.KJV: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
text.ASV: not that we are sufficient of ourselves, to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God;
text.WEB: not that we are sufficient of ourselves, to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God;

text.KJV: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
text.ASV: who also made us sufficient as ministers of a new covenant; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
text.WEB: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant; not of the letter, but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

text.KJV: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
text.ASV: But if the ministration of death, written, `and' engraven on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look stedfastly upon the face of Moses for the glory of his face; which `glory' was passing away:
text.WEB: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away;

text.KJV: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
text.ASV: how shall not rather the ministration of the spirit be with glory?
text.WEB: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

text.KJV: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
text.ASV: For if the ministration of condemnation hath glory, much rather doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
text.WEB: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

text.KJV: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
text.ASV: For verily that which hath been made glorious hath not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasseth.
text.WEB: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

text.KJV: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
text.ASV: For if that which passeth away `was' with glory, much more that which remaineth `is' in glory.
text.WEB: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

text.KJV: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
text.ASV: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,
text.WEB: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

text.KJV: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
text.ASV: and `are' not as Moses, `who' put a veil upon his face, that the children of Israel should not look stedfastly on the end of that which was passing away:
text.WEB: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face, that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

text.KJV: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
text.ASV: but their minds were hardened: for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remaineth, it not being revealed `to them' that it is done away in Christ.
text.WEB: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

text.KJV: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
text.ASV: But unto this day, whensoever Moses is read, a veil lieth upon their heart.
text.WEB: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

text.KJV: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
text.ASV: But whensoever it shall turn to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
text.WEB: But whenever one turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

text.KJV: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
text.ASV: Now the Lord is the Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, `there' is liberty.
text.WEB: Now the Lord is the Spirit and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

text.KJV: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
text.ASV: But we all, with unveiled face beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord the Spirit.
text.WEB: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

text.KJV: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
text.ASV: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we faint not:
text.WEB: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

text.KJV: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.
text.ASV: but we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.
text.WEB: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

text.KJV: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
text.ASV: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled in them that perish:
text.WEB: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying;

text.KJV: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
text.ASV: in whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn `upon them'.
text.WEB: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

text.KJV: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.
text.ASV: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake.
text.WEB: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake;

text.KJV: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
text.ASV: Seeing it is God, that said, Light shall shine out of darkness, who shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
text.ASV: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves;
text.WEB: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves.

text.KJV: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
text.ASV: `we are' pressed on every side, yet not straitened; perplexed, yet not unto despair;
text.WEB: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

text.KJV: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
text.ASV: pursued, yet not forsaken; smitten down, yet not destroyed;
text.WEB: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

text.KJV: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
text.ASV: always bearing about in the body the dying of Jesus, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our body.
text.WEB: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

text.KJV: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
text.ASV: For we who live are always delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our mortal flesh.
text.WEB: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

text.KJV: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
text.ASV: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
text.WEB: So then death works in us, but life in you.

text.KJV: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
text.ASV: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, I believed, and therefore did I speak; we also believe, and therefore also we speak;
text.WEB: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore also we speak;

text.KJV: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
text.ASV: knowing that he that raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also with Jesus, and shall present us with you.
text.WEB: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.

text.KJV: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
text.ASV: For all things `are' for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound unto the glory of God.
text.WEB: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

text.KJV: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
text.ASV: Wherefore we faint not; but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
text.WEB: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.

text.KJV: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
text.ASV: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, worketh for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory;
text.WEB: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory;

text.KJV: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
text.ASV: while we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
text.WEB: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

text.KJV: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
text.ASV: For we know that if the earthly house of our tabernacle be dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
text.WEB: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

text.KJV: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
text.ASV: For verily in this we groan, longing to be clothed upon with our habitation which is from heaven:
text.WEB: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven;

text.KJV: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
text.ASV: if so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
text.WEB: if so be that being clothed we will not be found naked.

text.KJV: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
text.ASV: For indeed we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened; not for that we would be unclothed, but that we would be clothed upon, that what is mortal may be swallowed up of life.
text.WEB: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened; not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

text.KJV: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
text.ASV: Now he that wrought us for this very thing is God, who gave unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
text.WEB: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

text.KJV: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
text.ASV: Being therefore always of good courage, and knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord
text.WEB: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

text.KJV: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
text.ASV: (for we walk by faith, not by sight);
text.WEB: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

text.KJV: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
text.ASV: we are of good courage, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be at home with the Lord.
text.WEB: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be at home with the Lord.

text.KJV: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
text.ASV: Wherefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well-pleasing unto him.
text.WEB: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

text.KJV: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
text.ASV: For we must all be made manifest before the judgment-seat of Christ; that each one may receive the things `done' in the body, according to what he hath done, whether `it be' good or bad.
text.WEB: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ; that each one may receive the things in the body, according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

text.KJV: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
text.ASV: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are made manifest unto God; and I hope that we are made manifest also in your consciences.
text.WEB: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God; and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

text.KJV: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
text.ASV: We are not again commending ourselves unto you, but `speak' as giving you occasion of glorying on our behalf, that ye may have wherewith to answer them that glory in appearance, and not in heart.
text.WEB: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance, and not in heart.

text.KJV: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
text.ASV: For whether we are beside ourselves, it is unto God; or whether we are of sober mind, it is unto you.
text.WEB: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

text.KJV: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
text.ASV: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that one died for all, therefore all died;
text.WEB: For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.

text.KJV: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
text.ASV: and he died for all, that they that live should no longer live unto themselves, but unto him who for their sakes died and rose again.
text.WEB: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

text.KJV: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
text.ASV: Wherefore we henceforth know no man after the flesh: even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know `him so' no more.
text.WEB: Therefore we know no one after the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

text.KJV: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
text.ASV: Wherefore if any man is in Christ, `he is' a new creature: the old things are passed away; behold, they are become new.
text.WEB: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

text.KJV: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
text.ASV: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ, and gave unto us the ministry of reconciliation;
text.WEB: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

text.KJV: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
text.ASV: to wit, that God was in Christ reconciling the world unto himself, not reckoning unto them their trespasses, and having committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
text.WEB: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

text.KJV: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
text.ASV: We are ambassadors therefore on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beseech `you' on behalf of Christ, be ye reconciled to God.
text.WEB: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

text.KJV: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
text.ASV: Him who knew no sin he made `to be' sin on our behalf; that we might become the righteousness of God in him.
text.WEB: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

text.KJV: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
text.ASV: And working together `with him' we entreat also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain
text.WEB: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain,

text.KJV: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
text.ASV: (for he saith, At an acceptable time I hearkened unto thee, And in a day of salvation did I succor thee: behold, now is the acceptable time; behold, now is the day of salvation):
text.WEB: for he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you, in a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

text.KJV: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
text.ASV: giving no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our ministration be not blamed;
text.WEB: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

text.KJV: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
text.ASV: but in everything commending ourselves, as ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
text.WEB: but in everything commending ourselves, as servants of God, in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

text.KJV: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
text.ASV: in stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;
text.WEB: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;

text.KJV: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
text.ASV: in pureness, in knowledge, in long suffering, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in love unfeigned,
text.WEB: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

text.KJV: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
text.ASV: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
text.WEB: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

text.KJV: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
text.ASV: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and `yet' true;
text.WEB: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;

text.KJV: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
text.ASV: as unknown, and `yet' well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
text.WEB: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as punished, and not killed;

text.KJV: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
text.ASV: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and `yet' possessing all things.
text.WEB: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

text.KJV: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
text.ASV: Our mouth is open unto you, O Corinthians, our heart is enlarged.
text.WEB: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

text.KJV: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
text.ASV: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own affections.
text.WEB: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

text.KJV: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
text.ASV: Now for a recompense in like kind (I speak as unto `my' children), be ye also enlarged.
text.WEB: Now in return, I speak as to my children, you also open your hearts.

text.KJV: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
text.ASV: Be not unequally yoked with unbelievers: for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? or what communion hath light with darkness?
text.WEB: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?

text.KJV: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
text.ASV: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what portion hath a believer with an unbeliever?
text.WEB: What agreement has Christ with Belial? Or what portion has a believer with an unbeliever?

text.KJV: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
text.ASV: And what agreement hath a temple of God with idols? for we are a temple of the living God; even as God said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
text.WEB: What agreement has a temple of God with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.”; ;

text.KJV: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you.
text.ASV: Wherefore Come ye out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, And touch no unclean thing; And I will receive you,
text.WEB: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.; ,

text.KJV: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
text.ASV: And will be to you a Father, And ye shall be to me sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
text.WEB: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”;

text.KJV: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
text.ASV: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
text.WEB: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

text.KJV: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
text.ASV: Open your hearts to us: we wronged no man, we corrupted no man, we took advantage of no man.
text.WEB: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

text.KJV: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
text.ASV: I say it not to condemn `you': for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die together and live together.
text.WEB: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before, that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

text.KJV: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
text.ASV: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying on your behalf: I am filled with comfort, I overflow with joy in all our affliction.
text.WEB: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

text.KJV: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
text.ASV: For even when we were come into Macedonia our flesh had no relief, but `we were' afflicted on every side; without `were' fightings, within `were' fears.
text.WEB: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

text.KJV: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
text.ASV: Nevertheless he that comforteth the lowly, `even' God, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
text.WEB: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

text.KJV: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
text.ASV: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort wherewith he was comforted in you, while he told us your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced yet more.
text.WEB: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you, while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced still more.

text.KJV: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
text.ASV: For though I made you sorry with my epistle, I do not regret it: though I did regret `it' (for I see that that epistle made you sorry, though but for a season),
text.WEB: For though I made you sorry with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you sorry, though just for a while.

text.KJV: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
text.ASV: I now rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye were made sorry unto repentance; for ye were made sorry after a godly sort, that ye might suffer loss by us in nothing.
text.WEB: I now rejoice, not that you were made sorry, but that you were made sorry to repentance. For you were made sorry in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

text.KJV: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
text.ASV: For godly sorrow worketh repentance unto salvation, `a repentance' which bringeth no regret: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
text.WEB: For godly sorrow produces repentance to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

text.KJV: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
text.ASV: For behold, this selfsame thing, that ye were made sorry after a godly sort, what earnest care it wrought in you, yea what clearing of yourselves, yea what indignation, yea what fear, yea what longing, yea what zeal, yea what avenging! In everything ye approved yourselves to be pure in the matter.
text.WEB: For behold, this same thing, that you were made sorry in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vengeance! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

text.KJV: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
text.ASV: So although I wrote unto you, I `wrote' not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be made manifest unto you in the sight of God.
text.WEB: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

text.KJV: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
text.ASV: Therefore we have been comforted: And in our comfort we joyed the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit hath been refreshed by you all.
text.WEB: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

text.KJV: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
text.ASV: For if in anything I have gloried to him on your behalf, I was not put to shame; but as we spake all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.
text.WEB: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

text.KJV: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
text.ASV: And his affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
text.WEB: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

text.KJV: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
text.ASV: I rejoice that in everything I am of good courage concerning you.
text.WEB: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

text.KJV: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
text.ASV: Moreover, brethren, we make known to you the grace of God which hath been given in the churches of Macedonia;
text.WEB: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia;

text.KJV: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
text.ASV: how that in much proof of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
text.WEB: how that in much proof of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

text.KJV: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
text.ASV: For according to their power, I bear witness, yea and beyond their power, `they gave' of their own accord,
text.WEB: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

text.KJV: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
text.ASV: beseeching us with much entreaty in regard of this grace and the fellowship in the ministering to the saints:
text.WEB: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

text.KJV: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
text.ASV: and `this', not as we had hoped, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
text.WEB: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

text.KJV: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
text.ASV: Insomuch that we exhorted Titus, that as he made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace also.
text.WEB: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

text.KJV: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
text.ASV: But as ye abound in everything, `in' faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and `in' all earnestness, and `in' your love to us, `see' that ye abound in this grace also.
text.WEB: But as you abound in everything, in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us, see that you also abound in this grace.

text.KJV: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
text.ASV: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
text.WEB: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

text.KJV: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
text.ASV: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might become rich.
text.WEB: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

text.KJV: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
text.ASV: And herein I give `my' judgment: for this is expedient for you, who were the first to make a beginning a year ago, not only to do, but also to will.
text.WEB: I give a judgment in this: for this is expedient for you, who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

text.KJV: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
text.ASV: But now complete the doing also; that as `there was' the readiness to will, so `there may be' the completion also out of your ability.
text.WEB: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

text.KJV: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
text.ASV: For if the readiness is there, `it is' acceptable according as `a man' hath, not according as `he' hath not.
text.WEB: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

text.KJV: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
text.ASV: For `I say' not `this' that others may be eased `and' ye distressed;
text.WEB: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

text.KJV: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
text.ASV: but by equality: your abundance `being a supply' at this present time for their want, that their abundance also may become `a supply' for your want; that there may be equality:
text.WEB: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack; that there may be equality.

text.KJV: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
text.ASV: as it is written, He that `gathered' much had nothing over; and he that `gathered' little had no lack.
text.WEB: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

text.KJV: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
text.ASV: But thanks be to God, who putteth the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
text.WEB: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

text.KJV: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
text.ASV: For he accepted indeed our exhortation; but being himself very earnest, he went forth unto you of his own accord.
text.WEB: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

text.KJV: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
text.ASV: And we have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the gospel `is spread' through all the churches;
text.WEB: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

text.KJV: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
text.ASV: and not only so, but who was also appointed by the churches to travel with us in `the matter of' this grace, which is ministered by us to the glory of the Lord, and `to show' our readiness:
text.WEB: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

text.KJV: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
text.ASV: Avoiding this, that any man should blame us in `the matter of' this bounty which is ministered by us:
text.WEB: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

text.KJV: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
text.ASV: for we take thought for things honorable, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
text.WEB: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

text.KJV: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
text.ASV: and we have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which `he hath' in you.
text.WEB: We have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

text.KJV: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
text.ASV: Whether `any inquire' about Titus, `he is' my partner and `my' fellow-worker to you-ward, or our brethren, `they are' the messengers of the churches, `they are' the glory of Christ.
text.WEB: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

text.KJV: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
text.ASV: Show ye therefore unto them in the face of the churches the proof of your love, and of our glorying on your behalf.
text.WEB: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

text.KJV: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
text.ASV: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
text.WEB: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

text.KJV: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
text.ASV: for I know your readiness, of which I glory on your behalf to them of Macedonia, that Achaia hath been prepared for a year past; and your zeal hath stirred up very many of them.
text.WEB: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to them of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for a year past. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

text.KJV: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
text.ASV: But I have sent the brethren, that our glorying on your behalf may not be made void in this respect; that, even as I said, ye may be prepared:
text.WEB: But I have sent the brothers that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

text.KJV: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
text.ASV: lest by any means, if there come with me any of Macedonia and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be put to shame in this confidence.
text.WEB: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

text.KJV: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
text.ASV: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your aforepromised bounty, that the same might be ready as a matter of bounty, and not of extortion.
text.WEB: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you, and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

text.KJV: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
text.ASV: But this `I say,' He that soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he that soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
text.WEB: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

text.KJV: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
text.ASV: `Let' each man `do' according as he hath purposed in his heart: not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
text.WEB: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart; not grudgingly, or under compulsion; for God loves a cheerful giver.

text.KJV: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
text.ASV: And God is able to make all grace abound unto you; that ye, having always all sufficiency in everything, may abound unto every good work:
text.WEB: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

text.KJV: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
text.ASV: as it is written, He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the poor; His righteousness abideth for ever.
text.WEB: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad, he has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”

text.KJV: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
text.ASV: And he that supplieth seed to the sower and bread for food, shall supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness:
text.WEB: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;

text.KJV: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
text.ASV: ye being enriched in everything unto all liberality, which worketh through us thanksgiving to God.
text.WEB: you being enriched in everything to all generosity, which produces through us thanksgiving to God.

text.KJV: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
text.ASV: For the ministration of this service not only filleth up the measure of the wants of the saints, but aboundeth also through many thanksgivings unto God;
text.WEB: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God;

text.KJV: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
text.ASV: seeing that through the proving `of you' by this ministration they glorify God for the obedience of your confession unto the gospel of Christ, and for the liberality of `your' contribution unto them and unto all;
text.WEB: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all;

text.KJV: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
text.ASV: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, long after you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.
text.WEB: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

text.KJV: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
text.ASV: Thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift.
text.WEB: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

text.KJV: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
text.ASV: Now I Paul myself entreat you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am of good courage toward you:
text.WEB: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ; I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

text.KJV: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
text.ASV: yea, I beseech you, that I may not when present show courage with the confidence wherewith I count to be bold against some, who count of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
text.WEB: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

text.KJV: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
text.ASV: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war according to the flesh
text.WEB: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

text.KJV: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
text.ASV: (for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the casting down of strongholds),
text.WEB: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

text.KJV: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
text.ASV: casting down imaginations, and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ;
text.WEB: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ;

text.KJV: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
text.ASV: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience shall be made full.
text.WEB: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience will be made full.

text.KJV: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
text.ASV: Ye look at the things that are before your face. If any man trusteth in himself that he is Christ's, let him consider this again with himself, that, even as he is Christ's, so also are we.
text.WEB: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that, even as he is Christ’s, so also we are Christ’s.

text.KJV: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
text.ASV: For though I should glory somewhat abundantly concerning our authority (which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for casting you down), I shall not be put to shame:
text.WEB: For though I should boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, (which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for casting you down) I will not be disappointed,

text.KJV: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
text.ASV: that I may not seem as if I would terrify you by my letters.
text.WEB: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

text.KJV: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
text.ASV: For, His letters, they say, are weighty and strong; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech of no account.
text.WEB: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

text.KJV: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
text.ASV: Let such a one reckon this, that, what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such `are we' also in deed when we are present.
text.WEB: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

text.KJV: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
text.ASV: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with certain of them that commend themselves: but they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
text.WEB: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

text.KJV: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
text.ASV: But we will not glory beyond `our' measure, but according to the measure of the province which God apportioned to us as a measure, to reach even unto you.
text.WEB: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

text.KJV: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
text.ASV: For we stretch not ourselves overmuch, as though we reached not unto you: for we came even as far as unto you in the gospel of Christ:
text.WEB: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

text.KJV: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
text.ASV: not glorying beyond `our' measure, `that is,' in other men's labors; but having hope that, as your faith groweth, we shall be magnified in you according to our province unto `further' abundance,
text.WEB: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

text.KJV: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
text.ASV: so as to preach the gospel even unto the parts beyond you, `and' not to glory in another's province in regard of things ready to our hand.
text.WEB: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

text.KJV: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
text.ASV: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
text.WEB: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

text.KJV: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
text.ASV: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
text.WEB: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

text.KJV: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
text.ASV: Would that ye could bear with me in a little foolishness: but indeed ye do bear with me.
text.WEB: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

text.KJV: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
text.ASV: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy: for I espoused you to one husband, that I might present you `as' a pure virgin to Christ.
text.WEB: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I married you to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

text.KJV: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
text.ASV: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve in his craftiness, your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity and the purity that is toward Christ.
text.WEB: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

text.KJV: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
text.ASV: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we did not preach, or `if' ye receive a different spirit, which ye did not receive, or a different gospel, which ye did not accept, ye do well to bear with `him'.
text.WEB: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus, whom we did not preach, or if you receive a different spirit, which you did not receive, or a different “good news”, which you did not accept, you put up with that well enough.

text.KJV: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
text.ASV: For I reckon that I am not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
text.WEB: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

text.KJV: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
text.ASV: But though `I be' rude in speech, yet `am I' not in knowledge; nay, in every way have we made `this' manifest unto you in all things.
text.WEB: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

text.KJV: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
text.ASV: Or did I commit a sin in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I preached to you the gospel of God for nought?
text.WEB: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?
