text.KJV: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
text.ASV: I robbed other churches, taking wages `of them' that I might minister unto you;
text.WEB: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

text.KJV: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
text.ASV: and when I was present with you and was in want, I was not a burden on any man; for the brethren, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my want; and in everything I kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and `so' will I keep `myself'.
text.WEB: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

text.KJV: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
text.ASV: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this glorying in the regions of Achaia.
text.WEB: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

text.KJV: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
text.ASV: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
text.WEB: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

text.KJV: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
text.ASV: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them that desire an occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
text.WEB: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them that desire an occasion, that in which they boast, they may be found even as we.

text.KJV: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
text.ASV: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, fashioning themselves into apostles of Christ.
text.WEB: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

text.KJV: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
text.ASV: And no marvel; for even Satan fashioneth himself into an angel of light.
text.WEB: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

text.KJV: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
text.ASV: It is no great thing therefore if his ministers also fashion themselves as ministers of righteousness, whose end shall be according to their works.
text.WEB: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

text.KJV: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
text.ASV: I say again, let no man think me foolish; but if `ye do', yet as foolish receive me, that I also may glory a little.
text.WEB: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

text.KJV: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
text.ASV: That which I speak, I speak not after the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of glorying.
text.WEB: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

text.KJV: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
text.ASV: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
text.WEB: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

text.KJV: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
text.ASV: For ye bear with the foolish gladly, being wise `yourselves'.
text.WEB: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

text.KJV: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
text.ASV: For ye bear with a man, if he bringeth you into bondage, if he devoureth you, if he taketh you `captive', if he exalteth himself, if he smiteth you on the face.
text.WEB: For you bear with a man, if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, if he strikes you on the face.

text.KJV: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
text.ASV: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet whereinsoever any is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
text.WEB: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

text.KJV: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
text.ASV: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
text.WEB: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

text.KJV: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
text.ASV: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself) I more; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths oft.
text.WEB: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself) I am more so; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths often.

text.KJV: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
text.ASV: Of the Jews five times received I forty `stripes' save one.
text.WEB: Five times from the Jews I received forty stripes minus one.

text.KJV: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
text.ASV: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day have I been in the deep;
text.WEB: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

text.KJV: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
text.ASV: `in' journeyings often, `in' perils of rivers, `in' perils of robbers, `in' perils from `my' countrymen, `in' perils from the Gentiles, `in' perils in the city, `in' perils in the wilderness, `in' perils in the sea, `in' perils among false brethren;
text.WEB: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

text.KJV: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
text.ASV: `in' labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
text.WEB: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

text.KJV: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
text.ASV: Besides those things that are without, there is that which presseth upon me daily, anxiety for all the churches.
text.WEB: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

text.KJV: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
text.ASV: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is caused to stumble, and I burn not?
text.WEB: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

text.KJV: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
text.ASV: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things that concern my weakness.
text.WEB: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

text.KJV: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
text.ASV: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, he who is blessed for evermore knoweth that I lie not.
text.WEB: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

text.KJV: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
text.ASV: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king guarded the city of the Damascenes in order to take me:
text.WEB: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

text.KJV: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
text.ASV: and through a window was I let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.
text.WEB: Through a window I was let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.

text.KJV: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
text.ASV: I must needs glory, though it is not expedient; but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
text.WEB: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

text.KJV: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
text.ASV: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I know not; or whether out of the body, I know not; God knoweth), such a one caught up even to the third heaven.
text.WEB: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows), such a one caught up into the third heaven.

text.KJV: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
text.ASV: And I know such a man (whether in the body, or apart from the body, I know not; God knoweth),
text.WEB: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

text.KJV: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
text.ASV: how that he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
text.WEB: how he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

text.KJV: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
text.ASV: On behalf of such a one will I glory: but on mine own behalf I will not glory, save in `my' weaknesses.
text.WEB: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

text.KJV: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
text.ASV: For if I should desire to glory, I shall not be foolish; for I shall speak the truth: but I forbear, lest any man should account of me above that which he seeth me `to be', or heareth from me.
text.WEB: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me, or hears from me.

text.KJV: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
text.ASV: And by reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted overmuch, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, that I should not be exalted overmuch.
text.WEB: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

text.KJV: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
text.ASV: Concerning this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
text.WEB: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

text.KJV: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
text.ASV: And he hath said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for `my' power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
text.WEB: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

text.KJV: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
text.ASV: Wherefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
text.WEB: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

text.KJV: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
text.ASV: I am become foolish: ye compelled me; for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing was I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I am nothing.
text.WEB: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for in nothing was I inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

text.KJV: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
text.ASV: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, by signs and wonders and mighty works.
text.WEB: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

text.KJV: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
text.ASV: For what is there wherein ye were made inferior to the rest of the churches, except `it be' that I myself was not a burden to you? forgive me this wrong.
text.WEB: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong.

text.KJV: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not your's but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
text.ASV: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be a burden to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
text.WEB: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

text.KJV: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
text.ASV: And I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
text.WEB: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

text.KJV: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
text.ASV: But be it so, I did not myself burden you; but, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
text.WEB: But be it so, I did not myself burden you. But, being crafty, I caught you with deception.

text.KJV: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
text.ASV: Did I take advantage of you by any one of them whom I have sent unto you?
text.WEB: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of them whom I have sent to you?

text.KJV: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
text.ASV: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? walked we not in the same spirit? `walked we' not in the same steps?
text.WEB: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

text.KJV: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
text.ASV: Ye think all this time that we are excusing ourselves unto you. In the sight of God speak we in Christ. But all things, beloved, `are' for your edifying.
text.WEB: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

text.KJV: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
text.ASV: For I fear, lest by any means, when I come, I should find you not such as I would, and should myself be found of you such as ye would not; lest by any means `there should be' strife, jealousy, wraths, factions, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults;
text.WEB: For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire; that by any means there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, riots;

text.KJV: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
text.ASV: lest again when I come my God should humble me before you, and I should mourn for many of them that have sinned heretofore, and repented not of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they committed.
text.WEB: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness and sexual immorality and lustfulness which they committed.

text.KJV: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
text.ASV: This is the third time I am coming to you. At the mouth of two witnesses or three shall every word established.
text.WEB: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

text.KJV: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
text.ASV: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, to them that have sinned heretofore, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;
text.WEB: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;

text.KJV: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
text.ASV: seeing that ye seek a proof of Christ that speaketh in me; who to you-ward is not weak, but is powerful in you:
text.WEB: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.

text.KJV: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
text.ASV: for he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him through the power of God toward you.
text.WEB: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

text.KJV: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
text.ASV: Try your own selves, whether ye are in the faith; prove your own selves. Or know ye not as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you? unless indeed ye be reprobate.
text.WEB: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

text.KJV: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
text.ASV: But I hope that ye shall know that we are not reprobate.
text.WEB: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

text.KJV: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
text.ASV: Now we pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that ye may do that which is honorable, though we be as reprobate.
text.WEB: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we are as reprobate.

text.KJV: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
text.ASV: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
text.WEB: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

text.KJV: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
text.ASV: For we rejoice, when we are weak, and ye are strong: this we also pray for, even your perfecting.
text.WEB: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. And this we also pray for, even your perfecting.

text.KJV: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
text.ASV: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not when present deal sharply, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for casting down.
text.WEB: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for tearing down.

text.KJV: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
text.ASV: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfected; be comforted; be of the same mind; live in peace: and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
text.WEB: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Be perfected, be comforted, be of the same mind, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

text.KJV: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
text.ASV: Salute one another with a holy kiss.
text.WEB: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

text.KJV: All the saints salute you.
text.ASV: All the saints salute you.
text.WEB: All the saints greet you.

text.KJV: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
text.ASV: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit, be with you all.
text.WEB: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit, be with you all. Amen.
